findings_addressed.oracle: After sandbox.attach_agents() completes, agent_after = sandbox.agent is independently asserted to be not None and agent_after.is_connected is True. The is_connected property reflects the outcome of the real GuestAgentClient.connect() call against the live TCP server fixture — a value the test never injected and cannot trivially predict without executing the real connect path.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/sandbox/qemu.py line 1953, delete or comment out `self._agent = GuestAgentClient(port=self._qemu_config.agent_port)` — the test's after-state assertion `assert agent_after is not None` would immediately fail since sandbox.agent would remain None.

notes: G0052 was a tautological init-invariant check that never called _attach_qemu_agents. Hardened into a before/after transition test: the before-state (agent is None) is captured in a separate local variable (agent_before) to avoid basedpyright's type-narrowing from assert-is-None permanently collapsing the property type to None in the function scope. The after-state asserts both that sandbox.agent is populated and that is_connected is True, exercised through a real TCP server fixture without any mocking. The listening_server fixture was added as a parameter since a real server is now required.
